maria (PM): starting a short decision thread on the priority admission rules for reserved pools. need a deterministic, debuggable policy before next sprint.

maria (PM): proposal: a small decision lattice using (1) explicit guarantee flag, (2) SLA tier, (3) latency-sensitive route tag, (4) burst-intent window, (5) recent quota burn score. outputs: admit / queue / preemptable.

jon (Eng-Platform): like it. implementation concern: runtime path must be cheap. store compact bitflags and a numeric burn_score, avoid DB lookups per request.

deepa (SRE): add fused signal for tail-latency regressions (1m p99 spike). if tenant correlates to regressions, deprioritize even if SLA high.

ryan (Product Ops): customers want two things: (A) explicit "guaranteed" opt-in for ultra-critical tenants, (B) transparent deny reason codes surfaced in Console.

maria (PM): lattice draft: TOP=HARD GUARANTEE (explicit flag + platinum SLA), MID=SOFT GUARANTEE (gold SLA or latency tag), BOTTOM=OPPORTUNISTIC. tie-breakers: burst window length then burn_score.

jon (Eng-Platform): sketch for evaluator (short-circuit): cache per-tenant flags in routing for 5s TTL, check pool.available, burst window heuristics, preempt budgets. cheap bitmask checks only.

deepa (SRE): preempting must be rate-limited: max-preempt-per-minute per-pool and a cooldown when we see elevated error/timeout rates. otherwise risk cascading failures.

ryan (Product Ops): launch acceptance: (1) console shows deny reason code, (2) feature flag per region for rollout, (3) canary test with 3 tenants simulating bursts and verifying no >5% p99 uplift.

maria (PM): rollout criteria agreed: canary p99 uplift <=5%, no more than 2 preempt events per alpha tenant in 24h, reason codes documented.

capacity-bot: scheduled: pool simulator run at 1755567905 to generate synthetic bursts for validation.

jon (Eng-Platform): tie-breaker idea: prefer tenants with higher committed capacity when otherwise equal (prevents gaming by ephemeral spikes).

deepa (SRE): require circuit breaker: if preempt rate > threshold OR queue latency > threshold, disable opportunistic admits for that pool automatically and alert.

maria (PM): action items: jon -> prototype short-circuit evaluator + caching path; deepa -> define circuit-break thresholds and cooldowns; ryan -> draft reason-code taxonomy and console UI mapping; maria -> write decision lattice doc + rollout checklist. target: spike-free canary next week.

ryan (Product Ops): will coordinate customer opt-ins once doc is ready.

maria (PM): keeping this thread as canonical. will post doc link when ready. :white_check_mark:
